summary: State-ranged dispatch on a UI/input-style object. Reads the state selector at this+0x1C and only proceeds through the update path for states 0-5; any other state returns immediately with the unmodified selector value. On the update path it transforms coordinate data, then branches on a sentinel check of the first DWORD: when this+0x0 equals -1 it runs the nested-loop path, otherwise it runs two arithmetic/processing helpers, and it always finishes with a final processing call whose result is returned.

Sentinel check: if the first DWORD of this equals -1 (0xFFFFFFFF), take the nested-loop path instead of the normal processing path.
When in the sentinel state (this+0x0 == -1), run NestedLoopCall on this.
When not in the sentinel state, run sub_410AF0 on this.
When not in the sentinel state, run ArithmeticComparison_df90 on this.
Final processing step sub_4BE010 runs on this after either branch; its result becomes the function result.
Return the result of the final processing call, or the unmodified state selector when the state guard rejected the dispatch.
